incidents.name: Laundromat 2016 contract drained via unguarded entrypoint
incidents.notes: The long-dormant Laundromat contract exposed a withdrawal path with no caller authorisation, letting an arbitrary address sweep its remaining ether balance.

sources.ref: onchain review: Laundromat 0x934cbbE5377358e6712b5f041D90313d935C501C created 2016-12-12T20:32:16Z by 0x8c6562b4742b428d6c5f6fab564498ac09cfb0c2, not the attack-tx sender 0xd6be07499d408454d090c96bd74a193f61f706f4; no EIP-1967 events and no delegatecall upgrade path, so the code was 3038.5 days old. Reported loss 1.5k USD, above the $1,000 floor.
